tool_args.rationale: Five observations with broad gradient variation support fitting the four-parameter guided mechanism directly. Fresh confirmation will test its predictive accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed s_grad span is 2.0, well above the stated 0.08 threshold, so the probe is not needed for the indicated branch.
The pilot gradients are subcritical, and the high-gradient probe is not available in the cost menu.
The verified co-activation guidance identifies the barrier-modulated siphon, which also incorporates the observed gradient dependence.
